quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Forensic referrals, investigations, compliance findings and enforcement actions are distinct stages and provider-scoped.
Biometric-retention permissions, National Security Determinations and retained records use different units and legal tests.
Border-inspection findings depend on inspection period, operational sample, recommendation status and publication lag.
Judicial and civil-service recruitment reports use applications, candidates, recommendations, appointments, exceptions and audits as different units.
Corporate, research and annual-account publications describe activity, governance and finance rather than local incident prevalence.
Forestry, mining, hydrographic and pipeline reports cannot be downscaled to parcel-level environmental or safety risk.
Sport, community-funding and museum reports use events, grants, visitors, projects and organisations rather than resident-level harm measures.
Domestic-abuse engagement, immigration-advice regulation, Prevent complaints and counter-extremism activity do not substitute for prevalence estimates.
SAR submissions record suspicion and intelligence reporting rather than proven offences or local fraud incidence.
